issues.description: Resource IDs are interpolated into URL paths without percent-encoding, so slashes or query characters can alter the requested endpoint.
Transient httpx transport errors are not caught or retried, so retry handling only works after an HTTP response exists.
Retry-After parsing only accepts numeric seconds and ignores valid HTTP-date Retry-After headers.
max_attempts is not validated, allowing zero or negative values to produce a misleading no-request error.
batch_create eagerly materializes the full iterable, which can exhaust memory despite documenting support for any number of tasks.
Pagination silently skips malformed result items instead of raising a schema/protocol error.
review always serializes note as null when omitted, which may differ from omitting the optional field.
Literal-typed enum fields are not validated at runtime, so invalid API values are accepted as if typed.
Frozen dataclasses expose mutable dict fields and to_dict returns shared nested objects, allowing external mutation of model state.
Shared kwargs dict confuses static typing and contributes to mypy failures in exception construction.
Package claims to be typed but does not ship a py.typed marker for downstream type checkers.
